# `planroom-extract`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** the `Extractor` and `Linker` traits, built-ins, the declarative runner, evidence location and verification, the git CLI adapter.
- **May depend on:** `contract`, and its allow-list in `boundaries.toml`: `tree-sitter` and grammars, `ignore`, `globset`, `regex`, `saphyr-parser`, `toml`, `pulldown-cmark`, `promql-parser`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `sha2`, `thiserror` [DR-79].
- **Must not:** other workspace crates; any other third-party crate; opening a socket [DR-79]; running anything from a scanned repo except `git` with hooks, external diffs and textconv off; a checkout or merge in a repo whose local git config names a command [DR-64].
- **How to test it:** `contract.rs` (every extractor over the fixture and a fuzz corpus), `link.rs`, per-extractor fixtures, the ABI floor test.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [Packs and extractors](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#packs-and-extractors); [The extractor contract](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#the-extractor-contract); [Hints and linkers](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#hints-and-linkers); [Adapters](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#adapters).
- **Records:** [DR-12](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-12-hints-built-in-linkers-endpoints-as-via-nodes-and-full-evidence-recall), [DR-16](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-16-the-git-cli-is-the-only-git-adapter), [DR-46](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-46-pack-data-tables-and-typed-emits), [DR-47](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-47-deterministic-scan-bounds-and-a-per-blob-fact-cache), [DR-74](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-74-repo-namespaces-that-survive-duplicates-and-renames-and-a-single-repos-state-in-its-git-directory), [DR-78](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-78-releases-users-install-detached-work-in-its-own-session-a-canvas-port-that-never-moves-and-machine-wide-files-across-versions).
